title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.00 (quiet) at 06:00 UTC on 20 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 20 日 06:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.00（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest hour-start estimated Kp = 0.00 (label 0Z). Last-180-sample maximum is 3.00 (at 04:30 UTC on 20 September); published-window maximum is 3.00 (same time). Hours through 23:00 UTC have rolled out of the public window; 00:00 UTC is partially rolled out (43 samples from 00:17). Completed bins 01:00–05:00 UTC closed at 2.00 / 2.33 / 0.67 / 3.00 / 3.00 respectively (01:00 peak 2.00 / 2Z at 01:17, 60 samples; 02:00 peak 2.33 / 2P at 02:21, closed at 2.33 / 2P, 60 samples; 03:00 peak 1.00 / 1Z at 03:42, closed at 0.67 / 1M, 60 samples; 04:00 peak 3.00 / 3Z at 04:30, closed at 3.00 / 3Z, 60 samples; 05:00 peak 3.00 / 3Z at 05:00, closed at 3.00 / 3Z, 60 samples). 06:00 UTC bin is in progress (15 samples; peak 0.00 / 0Z at 06:00; latest sample 0.00 / 0Z at 06:14). estimated_kp remains below 5.0.

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute (06:00 UTC). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window (~358 samples), so earlier hours fall out of the file. The in-progress 06:00 UTC hour currently has 15 samples and may be revised as NOAA updates.

title.en: A magnitude 5.0 earthquake occurred 103 km W of Hihifo, Tonga on 20 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 20 日，東加希希福以西約 103 公里發生規模 5.0 地震。

summary.en: USGS M4.5+ day feed: mb 5.0, depth about 10 km. Newly listed this hour. Current day-feed maximum remains mb 5.3 (us7000tinl, Guam); tied in magnitude with mww 5.3 (us7000timy, Reykjanes Ridge).
summary.zh: USGS M4.5+ 一日饋送：mb 5.0，深度約 10 公里。本輪新上架。一日饋送目前最大仍為 mb 5.3（us7000tinl，關島）；規模同為 5.3 的還有 mww 5.3（us7000timy，雷克雅內斯海嶺）。

evidence.method: Read the public USGS M4.5+ past-day GeoJSON feed and list new event IDs not already on the page.
evidence.limitations: Magnitudes and locations are preliminary and can be revised by USGS. The day feed only includes events currently listed at M4.5 or above.
